Bill.BriefDescription: Clarifying the legal status of children born from embryos transferred during assisted reproduction.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to children born from embryos transferred duringassisted reproduction; and adding a new section to chapter 26.26 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 26.26 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A child born to a woman as the result of the implantation of anembryo, which was donated by the genetic parents, or any person orentity with the legal authority to transfer such embryo, is presumed tobe the adopted child of the woman and, if married, of her husband. Alllegal authority to transfer the embryo, and the parental rights of theembryo donor, shall be irrevocably terminated in accordance with theterms of a written instrument executed prior to the implantation or thethawing and implantation of the embryo. A child born as the result ofsuch an embryo implantation shall be afforded all of the legal rightsand protection of any child adopted under the laws of this state. Upon application to a court of competent jurisdiction, the parentor parents of such a child shall be entitled to, but not required toobtain, a decree confirming the parent-child relationship. This p. 1 SB 6743section shall not apply to a child born to a surrogate mother who isnot genetically related to the child and who executes an appropriateagreement not inconsistent with the laws of this state.
